idea-plugin.name: hgrider
idea-plugin.description:
hgrider brings practical Mercurial (hg) tools to JetBrains IDEs.

  • Browse modified, added, removed and untracked files with different comparison modes (uncommitted, entire branch vs parent, vs parent branch HEAD, vs custom branch).
  • Filter/exclude the file list, open files or their Mercurial diff, revert selected changes.
  • Navigate TODO comments in changed files, including unsaved editor buffers.
  • Inspect Mercurial file history and diff historical revisions.
  • Export open editor files to a directory or Total Commander.

Requires the Mercurial command-line client available as hg on PATH.
